func verifyControlStreamConfig(actual jetstream.StreamConfig, replicas int) error {
	if (replicas != 1 && replicas != 3 && replicas != 5) || actual.Name != ControlStreamName ||
		actual.Replicas != replicas || actual.Retention != jetstream.LimitsPolicy ||
		actual.Storage != jetstream.FileStorage || actual.MaxConsumers != -1 ||
		actual.MaxMsgs != -1 || actual.MaxBytes != -1 ||
		actual.MaxMsgsPerSubject != -1 || actual.MaxAge != 0 || actual.Discard != jetstream.DiscardOld ||
		actual.MaxMsgSize > 0 || actual.DiscardNewPerSubject || actual.AllowRollup ||
		actual.AllowDirect || actual.MirrorDirect || actual.NoAck || actual.Sealed ||
		!actual.DenyDelete || !actual.DenyPurge || len(actual.Subjects) != 1 ||
		actual.Subjects[0] != controlStreamSubject || actual.Mirror != nil || len(actual.Sources) != 0 ||
		actual.SubjectTransform != nil || actual.RePublish != nil || actual.AllowMsgTTL ||
		actual.SubjectDeleteMarkerTTL != 0 || actual.AllowMsgSchedules ||
		actual.Metadata["terrascale-contract"] != "authority-log-v1" {
		return errors.New("existing control log has incompatible consistency, durability, or subject configuration")
	}
	return nil
}

func validFilesystem(filesystem observability.FilesystemView) bool {
	return protocol.ValidateSubjectToken(filesystem.Role) == nil &&
		len(filesystem.Path) <= 4096 && utf8.ValidString(filesystem.Path) &&
		filepath.IsAbs(filesystem.Path) && filepath.Clean(filesystem.Path) == filesystem.Path &&
		!strings.ContainsFunc(filesystem.Path, unicode.IsControl) &&
		filesystem.SizeBytes > 0 && filesystem.SizeBytes <= MaxFilesystemBytes &&
		filesystem.AvailBytes <= filesystem.FreeBytes && filesystem.FreeBytes <= filesystem.SizeBytes &&
		filesystem.Files <= MaxFilesystemBytes && filesystem.FilesFree <= filesystem.Files
}

type Scaler struct {
	Cell           string // e.g. "gru"; nodes are naming.RegionCell(strings.ToUpper(Cell)).Node(n)
	Pool           Pool
	Recipe         func(ctx context.Context) (Recipe, error)
	Reserve        func(context.Context, string, Recipe) (budget.Reservation, error)
	FunctionDemand func(context.Context) ([]CapacityDemand, error)
	FunctionRecipe func(context.Context, string) (Recipe, error)
	Control        api.ControlClient
	// CanRetire verifies owned retained-volume inventory and DATA retirement safety; nil holds scale-down.
	CanRetire func(ctx context.Context, node, instanceID string) error
	Loads     func() []NodeLoad                                            // latest load per node
	Allowance func(now time.Time) (int, bool)                              // false: no fresh allowance, so no growth
	Revoke    func(ctx context.Context, instanceID string) error           // ends a removed node's enrollment
	Backends  func(ctx context.Context, node, address string) (int, error) // load balancer backends still at the node
	Journal   func(ctx context.Context, decision decisionlog.Decision)
	// Cost is the region's spend for the home's allowances: TS-807's ocicost
	// supplies it, the per-region forecast with this region's pool nodes as
	// pending cost, and the node price. Nil, or failing, leaves spend unknown
	// and the global allocator holds growth.
	Cost func(ctx context.Context, pool PoolState) (Cost, error)
	// RTT is the latest measured round trip to each OCI region, from the Prober. Nil publishes none.
	RTT    func() map[string]time.Duration
	Leader authority.Fencer
	Store  RecordStore
	Now    func() time.Time

	mu               sync.Mutex
	history          History
	containerHistory History
	status           Status
	addresses        map[string]string
	heldKey          string // reason of the last journaled hold, without a cooldown's time left
	costErr          string // last cost error logged, so a repeat is not logged every tick
}
